messages:
deploy-bot: 📦 Starting image push: redwood/inference:canary-20260320 (commit abc1234) -> ghcr.io/redwood/inference (env: staging). pipeline: https://ci.redwood.dev/245

alex: ack, watching. please ping if anything hits >2 retries.

deploy-bot: ⏳ push step: blob upload chunk failed (504) to ghcr blob-svc, retrying (attempt 1/3)
```
ERROR: blob upload 504 upstream=ghcr blob_id=sha256:7f4a... chunk=3/12
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```

fiona: seeing a spike in staging egress ~2m ago, could be throttling at registry. do we want to throttle the canary or hold? @mike

mike: hold canary promotion for now. if retries hit 3/3, fallback to internal mirror and pin the mirror tag. don't auto-promote to dedicated until we confirm GHCR stability. :warning:

deploy-bot: retry attempt 2/3 failed (timeout). backoff=10s, next retry in 10s.

alex: can we surface the checksum on failure? i want to confirm it's a transport timeout vs content mismatch.

deploy-bot: attempt 3/3 -> failed. New error: checksum mismatch reported by ghcr after chunk finalise. moving to fallback workflow.
```
ERROR: digest mismatch expected=sha256:7f4a... got=sha256:6b2c...
```

sre-bot: INC created INC-2026-0319: ghcr blob uploads failing for staging canary. paging oncall. https://infra.redwood.dev/inc/INC-2026-0319

mike: good. deploy-bot, start mirror push to `registry.redwood.internal/redwood/inference:canary-20260320-mirror` and pin that tag as canary-staging current. Do not delete the failed GHCR attempt. Add note in the release log.

deploy-bot: mirror push started -> using curl upload shim to internal registry, chunk size 4MiB, concurrent 4.

alex: thanks. also open a follow-up to bump upload timeout and add stronger digest verification in the pipeline. i'll create a ticket.

mike: filed TRACK-1287 to add backoff/jitter and explicit digest compare step in CI.

deploy-bot: mirror push completed ✅. tag pinned: `canary-20260320-mirror` -> short id: d3f5bad. status: partial (ghcr=failed, mirror=success). scheduled ghcr re-attempt during next change-window (2026-03-20 23:00 UTC).

fiona: noted. we'll leave the canary traffic routed to mirror for staging tests. please escalate if mirror shows any regressions.

mike: action items captured: TRACK-1287 (pipeline fixes), INC-2026-0319 (infra investigation), and update release notes to mention mirror fallback and pinning. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
